nodes.label: Retention Finalization Saga
nodes.rationale: Final-result snapshots, per-service purge receipts, retries, and reconciliation address partial distributed finalization and deletion.

nodes.label: Direct Upload Recovery Controls
nodes.rationale: Short-lived policies, expiry handling, orphan cleanup, and idempotent completion recover incomplete direct uploads.

nodes.label: Grading Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Idempotent notifications and scheduled reconciliation address lost grading confirmations and distributed state drift.

nodes.label: Privacy Access Controls
nodes.rationale: Separate identity storage, restricted original access, short-lived URLs, internal HMAC context, and redacted logs mitigate identity disclosure.
